findings.claim: Manifest git provenance is resolved by running git in the process current working directory, not relative to the configured project or output path, so executions launched from another directory can record the wrong commit or no commit.
Checkpoint git provenance has the same current-working-directory dependency, which weakens recovery/debug evidence after resumed or relocated runs.

Training history and runtime files are written directly instead of through the repository's atomic write helper, so an interruption during write can leave a partially written CSV/JSON even though checkpoints and manifests use atomic replacement.
